hero_title: Sawal Hain? Hamare Paas Jawab Hain
hero_description: Bharat Sarathi ke bare mein aam sawalon ke jaldi jawab paayein. Jo aap dhoondh rahe hain, woh nahi mil raha? Hamari support team sahayata ke liye yahan hai.
grid_description: Yahan kuch sabse aam sawal hain jo hamare users puchte hain.

faq_list.question: Main Bharat Sarathi par register kaise karun?
faq_list.answer: 'Join' button par click karein aur shuru karne ke liye apni details bharein.

faq_list.question: Kya job listings verified hain?
faq_list.answer: Haan, hum yeh sunishchit karte hain ki sabhi listings pratishthit niyoktaon se hain.

faq_list.question: Kya main ek saath kai services ke liye apply kar sakta hoon?
faq_list.answer: Bilkul! Hamara platform aapki sabhi zarooraton ko ek hi jagah pura karne ke liye design kiya gaya hai.

faq_list.question: Kya Bharat Sarathi ka upyog karne ke liye koi shulk hai?
faq_list.answer: Nahi, hamari बुनियादी services sabhi users ke liye muft hain.

cta_description: Hamare FAQ section mein aapko Bharat Sarathi ke saath shuru karne ke liye sabhi jawab milenge.
